bidirectional_notes: Every public group in the API inventory has at least one private leaf.
Each private leaf is named by behavior rather than copied upstream nodeid.
The instruction describes all tested input domains, return shapes, order guarantees, side effects, and parser exceptions without embedding private assertions.
